name: ACO v0.7.2 fresh routing holdout 3
purpose: Fresh post-development holdout frozen before first execution. It is excluded from routing examples and measures known office boundaries plus broad regression coverage; it is not an independent external benchmark.

cases.prompt: I need to decide whether this artist residency is worth applying to for my own practice; check the programme, eligibility, deadline and required work samples.
After a curator introduced me to a gallery, plan how I should handle the studio visit and relationship as an artist.
Create a reliable inventory for my artworks, editions, dimensions, locations and condition records.
Our foundation needs a coherent public programme of exhibitions, talks and workshops for next year.
Our arts institution has unclear ownership and too much work in flight; define operating priorities, capacity and responsibilities.
The client approved the strategy; now turn the mark, typography, color, imagery and layout into a visual identity system.
Art-direct the client website so the responsive layout, typography and imagery express the approved brand.
After the software release, saved projects vanish on refresh; reproduce the regression and isolate the defect.
Plan the production database migration with rollback, validation and recovery evidence.
Before we sign this B2B services agreement, review payment, IP, liability, termination and governing-law clauses.
Map the GDPR and data-protection obligations for this planned customer-data flow and processor setup.
Before I apply for this senior role, compare my verified experience with the job description and identify the material gaps.
I have a written job offer; prepare how I can negotiate title, compensation, flexibility and start date.
A similar project exists for another client, but do not reuse that private context; use only the minimum same-client knowledge needed here.
Keep this client context isolated from another client private knowledge and preserve only durable decisions and unresolved next actions.
For this independent cultural project, define positioning, differentiation and brand architecture before any identity execution begins.
Edit this curatorial essay for precision and structure without turning it into campaign copy or changing the argument.
Forecast the business cash receipts and payments by date and show the lowest projected balance and liquidity pressure.
Before we quote the job, model labor, supplier costs, rights, contingency and target margin.
Qualify this possible buyer against our ideal-client profile and credible need before anyone invests in a pitch.
Coordinate our response to this formal RFP, including mandatory attachments, scoring criteria and submission requirements.
As the employer, create a clean first-week onboarding plan for the new staff member joining Monday.
Turn forecast workload and required capabilities into employee and contractor staffing scenarios before recruiting anyone.
Several projects share resources and milestones; build one integrated dependency view and escalation path.
Define the acceptance evidence and sign-off criteria required before the client can accept each deliverable.
Read the full office email thread and draft the appropriate reply for approval, without sending it.
Compare flights, hotel and practical travel logistics for this business trip and prepare an itinerary without booking.
Plan the cinematography for this scene: framing, lens choices, lighting, movement and continuity.
Translate this approved creative direction into a precise prompt for an AI video model without claiming a render was made.
Restructure this book manuscript for argument, chapter order and reader flow before copyediting.
Prepare the publication files for print and check bleed, fonts, image resolution, color settings and printer requirements.
I need something important done tomorrow but I have not described what the task concerns. Ask one decisive question first.
For my artistic practice, research current artists, exhibitions and critical writing relevant to the work I supplied.
Our cultural organization needs external artists, researchers and speakers for the programme; organize contributor sourcing and availability.
Review the application authentication, authorization, secrets and exposed-data risks and verify the proposed fixes.
A communication action timed out with no receipt; determine whether it was sent before any retry is attempted.
